verdict.rationale: Capacities' AI assistant can plan multi-step work and propose creates and updates for the user to approve. That is the product's own AI-driven route to changing multiple items, but nothing documents a true bulk or multi-select operation across many objects at once. The REST API and MCP integration are only developer building blocks and earn no credit. Missing for 10: an explicit bulk-edit, bulk-tag or bulk-delete capability, documentation that AI updates can span many items in one action, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
